# BLO-4296 — pin the `live_job_for_unknown_run` reason on the concurrent-run guard

Tracking: [BLO-4296](https://paperclip.blockcast.net/BLO/issues/BLO-4296) · PR: [#2503](https://github.com/Blockcast/paperclip/pull/2503)

## Files

- `src/server/execute.test.ts`

## What changed

Test-only local addition; no runtime behaviour changes and no upstream counterpart.

Adds a case asserting that a live Job carrying valid isolation labels but no
`paperclip.io/run-id` label is reported with reason `live_job_for_unknown_run`
and `errorCode: k8s_orphan_task_unknown`, without a run-table lookup. This is
the reason the `ClaudeK8sConcurrentRunBlockedRate` alert keys on, and it was
previously uncovered at the adapter level.
